title: When Can Self-Play Fix a False Belief? Answer Keys, Pass Bands and Replacement Rules in an Execution-Grounded Loop
abstract: arXiv:2611.06965v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Self-play loops in which a model writes tasks, derives an answer key and trains on its own matching solutions are often called grounded when the key comes from executing code. We ask which false beliefs such a loop removes. We run expert-iteration self-play with Qwen3-4B-Base on output-prediction tasks, vary the source of the answer key, and track natural beliefs about Python semantics and two misreadings of task specifications planted by fine-tuning ("at most n" read as < n; "the k-th smallest" read as 0-indexed). Executing the generator's own code gave a key that encoded the "at most" misreading on every audited task, and training on it never raised the truth rate above 0.03. A key from an implementation by the unplanted model, a teacher without the error, raised it to 0.23-0.58 after three rounds in four runs. translated_title: 自博弈何时能修复错误信念？执行接地循环中的答案密钥、通过区间与替换规则
translated_abstract: 在自我博弈循环中，模型编写任务、推导答案密钥，并基于自身生成的匹配解进行训练；当答案密钥来自执行代码时，这类循环常被称为“接地”（grounded）的。我们要问的是：这样的循环能消除哪些错误信念？我们在输出预测任务上使用 Qwen3-4B-Base 运行专家迭代式自我博弈，改变答案密钥的来源，并追踪关于 Python 语义的自然信念，以及通过微调植入的两种对任务规格的误读（把“至多 n”误读为 < n；把“第 k 小”误读为从 0 开始索引）。执行生成器自身代码所得到的答案密钥，在所有受审计任务中都编码了“至多”这一误读，基于它进行训练始终未能将正确率提升到 0.03 以上。而来自未植入该错误的模型（即一位没有此错误的“教师”）所给实现导出的答案密钥，在四次运行中经三轮训练后将其提升至 0.23–0.58。但答案密钥正确并不足够：将任务保持在 8 次尝试中解决 1–7 次的通过区间，几乎不接纳任何具有纠正作用的任务……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 在以执行为依据的自我博弈循环中，执行自身代码得到的答案密钥只会复制并固化模型的错误信念，只有当答案密钥来自不含该错误的“教师”实现、且通过区间能够接纳纠正性任务时，自我博弈才能真正修复被植入的错误信念。
en_tdlr: In an execution-grounded self-play loop, a planted false belief is fixed only when the answer key comes from a teacher implementation without the error and the pass band admits corrective tasks, since executing the model's own code merely replicates and entrenches its mistake.
